commands.result: TypeScript check and Vite production build passed

failed_acceptance.finding: The core uses FAILURE_TIME=1.35 seconds rather than 750ms and has no 800ms post-damage grace state, so frame gaps can begin the next damage window immediately.
Score increments on every fixed simulation step, multiplied by streak, rather than one point per survived active second.
The shipped controls use Space and R, not P/Escape and game-over Enter; there are no visible Pause/Resume or Restart buttons. The blur handler clears held input but does not pause the game.
stepGame accepts arbitrary dt without clamping an individual step to 100ms, and the tests do not cover the required clamp or post-damage grace lifecycle.
No assembled desktop/mobile browser check was executed, so 390x844 overflow and load-bearing text outside the canvas lack runtime evidence.

passed_observations: The state engine is DOM-free, seeded, deterministic for equal inputs, and immutable.
Keyboard steering, pause freeze, recenter, game-over, unit tests, and production build work under the candidate's own rules.
Fresh lockfile install, eight tests, and build are reproducible.
